{{Quote|A pocket-sized aquarium. Wonderful, isn't it? And, you can take it with you anywhere. And the tank is a snap to clean.''"<br />"''I hate fish|Saun Dann and an [[Unidentified Imperial guard|Imperial guard]]|<ref name="SWHS">''[[The Star Wars Holiday Special]]''</ref>}}
A '''pocket-sized aquarium''' was a novelty [[Aquarium/Legends|fish tank]] found in trade shops across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. It consisted of a small plastic cube which was fitted with a nutrient dispenser, filled with [[Water/Legends|water]], and contained a single<ref name="CSWE">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref> or multiple [[Fish/Legends|fish]]. The trader [[Saun Dann]] sold such aquariums in his shop on [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="SWHS" />
